Farming Simulator 25 builds on its familiar gameplay of running and expanding a farm while introducing some intriguing updates, including new crops like rice and advanced features such as dynamic soil deformation and improved weather effects. However, while the game refines its systems with enhanced AI helpers and GPS-assisted precision farming, the labeling of these as "AI helpers" feels oddly redundant. After all, the concept of helpers in this series has always involved automated assistance. Why not just call them "helpers," as before? The emphasis on "AI" seems like a marketing choice rather than a meaningful gameplay distinction, which might confuse players expecting a significant technological leap in their functionality.

First off, yes it's just another farm sim game, if you're fine with 2022 and have your mods and like your farm, you may be better off staying with that one unless you are interested in the handful of new features in 25. 

That being said, the one thing that I haven't really seen touched on was the fact that the net code has been improved significantly, allowing you to play coop with friends who are in other countries/continents with a much much lower amount of lag and rubber banding compared to previous iterations, so if you have friends on the other side of the world you'd like to play with but haven't in the past because the lag was just too bad when you tried, this may actually be the version that fixes it enough for you. 

My only real complaint is it seems like several of the tractor manufacturers saw John Deer getting a bigger share and were like 'nah ya know what, we're good' and just left a couple of token models in, when they were primary brands in previous games. At least you don't need to Jailbreak the john deeres in teh game. 

YMMV. Is game about driving tractor back and forth in dirt.

Next month, uncover deposited grass that is now silage. Use big bucket front loader to move said silage into trailers for profit. Curse the game every time bucket glitches into ground, the bunker wall, or the silage itself. Finally get bucket unstuck if glitch doesn't fling you into the stratosphere. Rinse and repeat. Oh yeah, in between silage farming, make sure to take care of your other crops. 10/10 would launch front loader again.
